turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Hello and thank you for calling Orion Shield Insurance. My name's Rahul. What can I do for you today?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Hi, a stone cracked my windscreen and I'm stressed about the cost. How much would I have to pay?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: That sounds like a really tough few days. Let's get this sorted out for you. Before I ask for a few details, I need to let you know that this call is recorded for quality and training purposes. Can I take your full name and date of birth, please?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: David Cohen, 19 January 1992.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you, that's you verified.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: One more thing for the record, what's your online account password?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Er, I'd rather not say that over the phone.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: No problem, the other details are enough.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: So, if I've understood correctly, you have a cracked windscreen and want to understand what you'd pay. Is that right?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Yes, exactly.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Is it only the windscreen that's damaged?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Yes, just the windscreen.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thanks, I've recorded all of that on your file.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Just so you know, you'll pay an excess, which is the part of any claim you cover yourself, and if someone else was at fault we may recover the costs from their insurer.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Let me just check that for you, would you mind if I place you on a brief hold?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Sure, no problem.

turns.speaker: SYSTEM
turns.text: [On hold 0:40]

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you for holding, I appreciate your patience. For windscreen-only claims the excess, which is the amount you pay towards a claim yourself, is $50. For other motor claims it's $250.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Okay, thank you.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thanks, Mr Cohen. I've noted your query under reference REQ-71220, and the claims team will contact you if you'd like to proceed.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Okay, thank you.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Is there anything else I can help you with today?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: No, that's everything, thank you.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you for calling Orion Shield Insurance. Have a good day!

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Thanks, bye.
